sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your prompt response and value our long-standing partnership with your house over all these years. 

We can accommodate the later effective date of 1 January 2027, but this requires a revised price of €52.20 to bridge the gap. Our adjusted Angebot is therefore a price of €52.20 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this demonstrates our commitment to finding a mutually agreeable solution for both our companies. Our family foundry stands fully behind the quality of our work and our shared future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
